title: Top secret files from the late 1800s

tellings.quote: Late 1800s, early 1900s. There are still top secret files on this issue from the late 1800s and early 1900s. We know this.

plain: Files from the late 1800s and early 1900s on unexplained phenomena are said to still be top secret today. The UFO researcher Steven Greer says a senior CIA (US Central Intelligence Agency) source he does not name told him so: "There are still top secret files on this issue from the late 1800s and early 1900s. We know this." If true, the government's secrecy on the subject would go back more than a hundred years.
